final_response:
> I read this as research and audit - statically analyze the remote/mobile UI performance and write the lane report.

The remote and mobile UI performance audit has been completed and written to `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/docs/frontend-perf/audit-remote.md`.

### Summary of Audit
- **F-remote-01 (High):** `ui/src/main.tsx:3` — Root entry point statically imports the desktop `App` alongside `RemoteApp`, bundling the complete desktop application into the initial chunk loaded by mobile browsers.
- **F-remote-02 (Low):** `ui/src/remote/RemoteTerminal.tsx:210` — Ephemeral `TextEncoder` allocated on every keystroke in `sendKey` rather than being reused from module scope.
- **Non-findings / accepted patterns:** Decoupled WebSocket data pump writing directly to xterm without React re-renders, xterm WebGL attachment and teardown safety, coalesced rAF viewport resizing, memoized hierarchy building, and lightweight pairing form without QR generation overhead.

### Verification
Verified file format, section headers (`# Audit:`, `## Findings`, `## Non-findings / accepted`, `## Scan coverage`), required finding attributes (`File`, `Severity`, `Mechanism`, `Hot path`, `Suggested fix`, `Write scope`, `RED proof`), and ensured no out-of-scope production files or commits were created.
